ResearchProjectDef.label: arm blade module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a bionic module that allows the user to extend a concealed blade from within their forearm.
Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bionic claw module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a bionic module that allows the user to extend retractable plasteel claws from each of their digits and grants their hand enough grip strength to crush skulls like eggshells.
Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.

ResearchProjectDef.label: zeusknuckles module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a set of hardened bionic knuckles with an embedded EMP capacitor. Upon impact, it blasts the target with an EMP burst in addition to the physical damage.
Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.

ResearchProjectDef.label: venom fangs module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a bionic module consisting of a pair of injectors implanted through the canine teeth, connected to a venom pump. The user can bite an enemy, extend the injectors, and pump venom into the target.
Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.

ResearchProjectDef.label: detoxifier kidney module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a bionic module that, using a series of nanofilters, can rapidly remove a vast range of toxins from the blood, making it effective against environmental toxins, venoms, and injected poisons.
Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.

ResearchProjectDef.label: detoxifier lung module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a bionic module that uses microfilters to reduce the intake of environmental toxins, allowing the user to survive longer in polluted environments.
Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.

ResearchProjectDef.label: revenant vertebrae module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a bionic module that allows the user to temporarily become invisible. The module is crafted from a modified revenant spine and uses archotech shards to restrain the dormant revenant. The user can manipulate the visual centers of those nearby, effectively turning themself invisible for a short time.
Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.
